'''Ring Defenders''' was the name given to those [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]] who maintained a vigil over the [[Suarbi 7|Suarbi]] system, diverting and distracting enemies through the use of their [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|abilities]].
